hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md ]; then echo '## Recent locked decisions (plan file)'; echo ''; grep -E '^\| [0-9]+ \|' .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md | tail -3 | awk -F'|' '{printf "- **Q%s** -- %s\n", $2, $3}' | sed 's/^- \*\*Q */- **Q/; s/ \*\*/**/'; echo ''; echo '_Full plan: .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md_'; fi
